title: 第10章 拿到枪械！开火！
slug: 万界词条从基因锁词条开始
content_zh:
第(1/3)页

“算了，不管这些，反正距离这个试炼世界结束还有好几天。”

“到时候，如果有空，我就过去看看情况。”

“或许，还能捡漏呢？”

罗兰伸手关掉小型无线电，免得他离开之后，声音吸引了其他丧尸过来。

“现在，按照原计划，先去拿枪，然后获取晶核，加速修炼！”

罗兰收拾好东西，穿上用清水擦拭过的皮甲，然后便手持长刀走出了房间。

“不行，这地方不能呆了！”

刚离开房间来到走廊上，罗兰就被走廊中的气味弄得恶心无比。

只见走廊上到处都是尸体和血液，不过这些死去多时的尸体，却并没有腐烂。

仿佛这些尸体中的丧尸病毒，让各种微生物都无法存活下来，因此这么多天过去，尸体依旧没有腐烂的迹象。

“等回来之后，就换个地方。”

念头闪过，罗兰迈步，避开地上的尸体和血迹，朝着楼下走去。

他所在的地方，是一栋公寓楼，有六层高，此刻罗兰从三楼一路往下，小心避开丧尸，实在避不开的丧尸，他就将其快速击杀。

刀法等级到了3级，发劲等级到了1级的罗兰，现在实力比刚进入这个试炼世界之时还要强上一些，他杀这些普通丧尸时更加迅捷快速。

现在的丧尸，就算是两个一起上，也无法让罗兰受伤！

不过如果三个丧尸一起上的话，罗兰也无法保证自己完全不会受伤。

如果四个一起上，那么受伤是必然的。

除非他能利用地形，不断游斗，让自己在同一时间只会和一个丧尸交手，那无论丧尸有多少，在体能耗尽前，罗兰都不会有任何受伤的可能性。

“还好，公寓楼中的丧尸，有一部分都困在的房间中无法出来，不然的话，我想要到达一楼，恐怕还需要一两天的时间不断厮杀。”

杀了将近十个丧尸之后，罗兰这才来到了公寓楼的门口。

他擦了擦额头上的细汗，旋即看向大门外。

公寓楼的大门，是个透明的玻璃门，而在大门外，罗兰看到有许多丧尸在街道上游荡。

这些丧尸有时站在原地一动不动，有时又会偶尔发出低沉嘶吼。

Page (1/3)

"Forget it, no matter what, there are still several days before the end of this trial world."

"At that time, if I have time, I will go over and take a look at the situation."

"Perhaps, we can still pick up the leaks?"

Roland reached out and turned off the small radio to prevent the sound from attracting other zombies after he left.

"Now, according to the original plan, go get the gun first, and then get the crystal core to speed up your training!"

Roland packed his things, put on the leather armor that had been wiped with clean water, and then walked out of the room with a long knife.

"No, we can't stay in this place!"

As soon as he left the room and entered the corridor, Roland was made extremely nauseous by the smell in the corridor.

I saw corpses and blood everywhere in the corridor, but these corpses that had been dead for a long time did not rot.

It seems that the zombie virus in these corpses prevents all kinds of microorganisms from surviving, so after so many days, the corpses still show no signs of decay.

"When we get back, we'll change places."

The thought flashed through his mind, and Roland took a step, avoiding the corpses and blood stains on the ground, and headed downstairs.

The place he was in was a six-story apartment building. At this moment, Roland was going down from the third floor, carefully avoiding zombies. If he couldn't avoid the zombies, he would quickly kill them.

Roland, whose sword skill level has reached level 3 and whose power level has reached level 1, is now stronger than when he first entered this trial world. He can kill these ordinary zombies more quickly and quickly.

Today's zombies, even if two of them come together, can't hurt Roland!

However, if three zombies come together, Roland cannot guarantee that he will not be injured at all.

If all four are involved together, injuries are inevitable.

Unless he could take advantage of the terrain and keep fighting so that he could only fight one zombie at a time, no matter how many zombies there were, there would be no possibility of Roland being injured before his physical energy was exhausted.

"Fortunately, some of the zombies in the apartment building are trapped in the rooms and cannot come out. Otherwise, if I want to reach the first floor, I will probably need another day or two of constant fighting."

After killing nearly ten zombies, Roland arrived at the door of the apartment building.

He wiped the sweat from his forehead and immediately looked outside the door.

The door of the apartment building was a transparent glass door, and outside the door, Roland saw many zombies wandering on the street.

Sometimes these zombies stand motionless, and sometimes they occasionally let out low roars.
